label: Attainment of a greatest represented…: GreatestBeingDegreeAttained InAct esse value means there…
term: attainment of a greatest represented degree in the selected being respect
definition: GreatestBeingDegreeAttained InAct esse value means there exists g with GreatestDegreeBearer InAct esse value g: g itself has esse and value g is greatest in the image of all esse bearers. This concerns the supplied BEING respect only, with a supplied Preorder of degrees. It asserts neither greatestness for unrelated perfections, linearity, strict primacy, injective grading, actual-world presence nor modal necessity.
note: Read the explicit maxime ens assertion in the complete Fourth Way. This remains an OPEN attainment commitment and an interpreted value map, not a theorem from the old weak H, the MostTrue bridge or mere existence of some grade. No comparison with old MoreIn is silently supplied.
